entries.title: Volunteer Away Your Fines
entries.description:
Volunteer Away Your Fines at 20 per hour and earn community service hours while helping the library maintain a clean and welcoming environment.nbsp;
Volunteers may be asked to assist with:
Cleaning materials, bookshelves, furniture, and computersChildren's toys cleanup
Details and Requirements:
Must be able to commit to the 60-minute sessionAnyone under the age of 15 must volunteer alongside a parent/guardianNo experience or special skills necessaryThe library will provide supplies
Space is limited.

entries.title: Hometown Holidays
entries.description: Step into the main hall to explore two exhibitions: Doña Juana Briones, honoring the 19th-century healer and entrepreneur, and I AM PALO ALTO, where you can chat with “Pam,” our AI digital docent, about the lives of Jane Stanford, Sam McDonald, and Thomas Foon Chew.

entries.title: TLAB presents: STEM Sense Workshop [Ages  8-11]
entries.description: Through demos, interactive learning, and hands-on challenges, students will practice asking questions, making predictions, testing ideas, and discovering how scientific concepts connect to the world around them.
